CHROMIUM: drm/tegra: Add crtc & encoder suspend support This patch implements/modifies tegra crtc & encoder's .disable to support system suspend. Basically in encoder's .disable, we'll turn off panel and sor, and in crtc's .disable, we'll turn off tegra dc and powergate it. Change-Id: I02a1c9935dc263a4ad185e041ad68a53848c422f Signed-off-by: Mark Zhang <markz@gpartner-nvidia.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/360746 Commit-Ready: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org> Tested-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: drm/tegra: Make sure dc is on when doing DPAUX operation DPAUX power relies on dc power partition. So this patch makes sure that dc power partition is turned on before doing any DPAUX operations. The dc power partition will be turned off when dc suspends. While TegraDRM connector->detect is the first function being called by userspace when doing the mode setting. So we turn on dc power partition at that time. BUG=chrome-os-partner:54787 TEST="restart ui" twice doesn't crash the system Change-Id: I29d9b5006c29a664ad1094b1a76d18ee0503dbbc Signed-off-by: Mark Zhang <markz@gpartner-nvidia.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/360747 Commit-Ready: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org> Tested-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>
